name: ENTIA Entity Verification
description: Verified business identity for AI agents from official public registries: 11.3M entities, 40.3M BORME mercantile acts, GLEIF LEI and real-time EU VAT validation via VIES. 12 tools. Free preview without API key (entity_lookup). Monthly EUR plans, no overage (HTTP 429 at quota). API/MCP access is not a data licence: AI training/bulk extraction requires ENTIA-LTC-1.0. Pricing: https://entia.systems/pricing

env.name: ENTIA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key (entia_live_...) for paid plans. Without a key, entity_lookup returns a free preview. Plans: https://entia.systems/pricing

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: Look up any business entity by name, CIF/NIF, EU VAT or LEI. Cross-checks BORME, VIES, GLEIF.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search verified entities by name, keyword, country, city or sector.

tools.name: verify_vat
tools.description: Real-time EU VAT validation via VIES (27 member states).

tools.name: zone_profile
tools.description: Socioeconomic profile of a Spanish postal code (INE/SEPE/AEAT): income, employment, business density.

tools.name: get_competitors
tools.description: Real competitors in the same sector and city. Spain only on the public surface.

tools.name: get_showcase
tools.description: Curated IBEX35 + EU showcase entities. Free, does not consume quota.

tools.name: professional_lookup
tools.description: Verify professional registrations across 24 Spanish health/legal/psychology verticals. Requires DPA (GDPR Art. 28).

tools.name: get_full_dossier
tools.description: Aggregator: 90+ fields about an entity in one call (combines 4 ENTIA sources).

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Live platform stats: entities, sources. Free, does not consume quota.

tools.name: run_risk_audit
tools.description: AI-readiness + digital risk audit for any domain.

tools.name: get_entia_home
tools.description: Full Schema.org JSON-LD @graph for an entity (Entia Home).

tools.name: get_entity_home_projection
tools.description: Read the entity_home_projection.v1 snapshot for an Entia Home (claims + projection + policy).
